programme.title: War Machines S1 - "Triumphant On Land"
programme.desc: Highlighting some of the most influential movers ever to take to the battlefield including some of the most infamous tanks.

programme.title: War Machines S1 - "Ruling The Waves"
programme.desc: From the most deadly submarines ever seen to the infamous destroyers of the Second World War, this episode is the story of what it takes to rule the waves.

programme.title: War Machines S1 - "Conqeuring The Sky"
programme.desc: The evolution of mankind's desire to fly higher, move faster, and kill better all from within the cockpit.

programme.title: War Machines S1 - "Ultimate Annihilation"
programme.desc: Explore the destructive capability of machinery across all scales, the inventions designed to unleash maximum carnage, then and now.

programme.title: Battle Factory S1 - "A Parajet, a Hovercraft, a Camo Jacket, and a Portable Military Shelter"
programme.sub-title: A Parajet, a Hovercraft, a Camo Jacket, and a Portable Military Shelter
programme.desc: As lightweight aluminum is cut and tooled, it will become the frame of a personal flying machine. Used by military operatives, drug enforcement agents, and first responders – it gets you in and out fast, whether you are carrying a camera or a gun.

programme.title: Battle Factory S1 - "A Sniper Rifle, a Zeppelin, a Ka-Bar Knife, and Dragon Eggs"
programme.sub-title: A Sniper Rifle, a Zeppelin, a Ka-Bar Knife, and Dragon Eggs
programme.desc: In 48 hours, a block of metal will be formed into the most accurate weapon on earth: the AX-338 Sniper Rifle. In a warzone, police stand off, or hostage taking, the sniper is often the only solution to a bad situation.

programme.title: Battle Factory S1 - "An Amphibious Armoured Vehicle, a Bomb Robot, and a Life Raft"
programme.sub-title: An Amphibious Armoured Vehicle, a Bomb Robot, and a Life Raft
programme.desc: When a steel plated hull is fitted with controls on the inside and tracks on the outside, it’ll become the Viking BVS10 –an armoured amphibious personnel carrier that can get troops in and out of any combat zone, even if it has to go through snow, sand, or water to get there.

programme.title: Battle Factory S1 - "A Helmet, a Zippo, a Fuel Bladder, and a Simulated IED"
programme.sub-title: A Helmet, a Zippo, a Fuel Bladder, and a Simulated IED
programme.desc: When a series of delicate snowflake shaped sheets of Aramid are pressed together, they’ll form a piece of headgear that’s comfortable enough to wear to war, and tough enough to take a bullet.

programme.title: Battle Factory S1 - "A Pistol, a Firetruck, a Ghillie Suit, and an Armored Fighting Vehicle"
programme.sub-title: A Pistol, a Firetruck, a Ghillie Suit, and an Armored Fighting Vehicle
programme.desc: At the Cabot factory in Pennsylvania, USA, a block of steel will be transformed by innovation and artistry into the ultimate update of an American classic. The 1911 did tours of duty in both world wars and Vietnam, and is still prized today by collectors and enthusiasts.

programme.title: Battle Factory S1 - "A Cannon, a Parachute, a Medal, and a Stretcher"
programme.sub-title: A Cannon, a Parachute, a Medal, and a Stretcher
programme.desc: A battle tank is only as effective as its gun, and for the Stryker vehicle, that’s the M68 105mm cannon. A tube of forged steel will be hammered into the one of the most powerful and famous cannons in modern warfare.

programme.title: Battle Factory S1 - "A Grenade Launcher, a Flight Simulator, and Ration Packs"
programme.sub-title: A Grenade Launcher, a Flight Simulator, and Ration Packs
programme.desc: The M203 Grenade Launcher is a single shot launcher designed to attach under a rifle barrel. Using the latest technology, bits of plastic and a block of aluminum will be melted, molded, and cut to create a snap-on weapon that increases the firepower in a soldier’s hands by a long shot.

programme.title: Battle Factory S1 - "Jaws of Life, a Tank, and a Watch"
programme.sub-title: Jaws of Life, a Tank, and a Watch
programme.desc: A series of handcrafted, precision-cut pieces will come together to create a first response tool capable of chewing through metal like a can opener. At the scene of an accident, a natural disaster, or in the combat zone, the Jaws of Life can cut through just about anything .

programme.title: Bright Now S1 - "African Animal Rescue"
programme.desc: The staff of South Africa's Manyoni Private Game Reserve passionately care for some of the world's most exotic and endangered wild animals. From treating elephant foot infections to testing cheetahs for tuberculosis, they never know what to expect.

programme.title: Top 10: The Art of Architecture S1 - "Playful Design: Feast for the Eyes"
programme.sub-title: Playful Design: Feast for the Eyes
programme.desc: Buildings with eccentric and unorthodox designs often have methods behind their madness, and serve to remind us of moments in history.

programme.title: Top 10: The Art of Architecture S1 - "Theatres and Opera Houses: Unforgettable Experiences"
programme.sub-title: Theatres and Opera Houses: Unforgettable Experiences
programme.desc: Theaters and opera houses are wonders of stage technology, as well as exquisite masterpieces of modern or historic architecture.

programme.title: The Aviators S1 - "Can a Non-pilot Land an Airliner?"
programme.sub-title: Can a Non-pilot Land an Airliner?
programme.desc: InWonder delivers an engaging exploration of science, technology, and nature, offering a unique perspective on the mysteries of the human brain, world wonders, and everyday engineering.

programme.title: The Aviators S1 - "Air Traffic Control Tower"
programme.desc: An inside look at one of the most technologically advanced towers in the world.

programme.title: The Aviators S1 - "Rick Volker"
programme.desc: Sara interviews the air show performer during the off-season to talk about spring conditioning.

programme.title: The Aviators S1 - "En Route Control"
programme.desc: Most air traffic control does NOT take place in a tower but rather in an area control center like this.

programme.title: The Aviators S1 - "Aircraft Auctions"
programme.desc: Getting a bargain while purchasing aircraft in a unique and fast-paced way.

programme.title: The Aviators S1 - "Mikey McBryan"
programme.desc: Anthony chats with the star of TV’s ‘Ice Pilots’.

programme.title: The Aviators S1 - "Day in the Life of an Airline Pilot"
programme.sub-title: Day in the Life of an Airline Pilot
programme.desc: Raeleen shows us what a typical day is like for her as an airline first officer.

programme.title: The Aviators S1 - "Cross Border Flying"
programme.desc: Anthony flies the 206 from Canada to the United States and checks in with Customs.

programme.title: Strip The City S2 - "Chicago"
programme.desc: CGI strips Chicago’s Willis Tower and L-rail to reveal how green roofs, deep tunnels, and heat-proofed bridges protect 10 million citizens.

programme.title: Strip The City S2 - "Machu Picchu"
programme.desc: Stripping away the granite, CGI reveals the quake-proof walls and hidden canals that allowed Machu Picchu to survive at 11,000 feet.

programme.title: Strip The City S2 - "Los Angeles"
programme.desc: Stripping Los Angeles to its core, CGI reveals the hidden steel and fault lines that help this earthquake-prone city survive "the Big One."

programme.title: Strip The City S2 - "New Orleans"
programme.desc: CGI peels back the Superdome and the city’s silt to reveal the massive pumps and barriers keeping New Orleans from sinking.

programme.title: Heavy Lifting S1 - "Just Like Downtown"
programme.desc: Dave deals with a messy train, J.P. takes down a tree, Regional Crane lifts a huge wall, and Maxum Crane moves a couch to a high-rise.

programme.title: Heavy Lifting S1 - "Taking out the Trash"
programme.desc: Dave faces a tricky residential lift, J.P. races between last-minute jobs, and Brad and Nathan Moore help a family’s dream come true.

programme.title: Heavy Lifting S1 - "Bridging the Gap"
programme.desc: Nathan battles strong winds on a big roofing job, Dave handles an easy lift, J.P. moves a hot tub, and Dan faces confusion on a bridge build.

programme.title: Heavy Lifting S1 - "Special Delivery"
programme.desc: Regional Crane’s new machine hits a hydraulic snag. Dave uses his downtime for repairs, and Brad helps clear a stand of pine trees.

programme.title: Heavy Lifting S1 - "The Need for Speed"
programme.desc: Maxum Crane tackles a tight indoor lift, JP removes a 60-year-old fighter jet, and Brad and Nathan race to install farm machinery before a storm hits.

programme.title: Heavy Lifting S1 - "Son of a Sailor"
programme.desc: Dan and Francis pull boats for winter. Maxum replaces a ferry engine. Brad and Nathan face tricky container moves. J.P. finishes by greasing the boom.

programme.title: Heavy Lifting S1 - "Under Construction"
programme.desc: Maxum swaps a grain handler, J.P. faces a tricky lift with a contractor, Brad and Nathan lift slabs in rain, and Dave visits a theme park.

programme.title: Heavy Lifting S1 - "Day or Night"
programme.desc: Dave handles a college AC unit and a historic ride, Brad and Nathan battle wind lifting trusses, and Dan and Francis work the night shift underground.

programme.title: Heavy Lifting S1 - "Ticket to Ride"
programme.desc: Brad and Nathan build a fire training unit, Dave works on amusement rides, and Dan and Francis lift a massive excavator from a construction pit.
